prompt_used: You are given an image. Write a detailed natural language prompt that could have been used to generate this image. Focus on the most salient and unique visual elements such as the subjects, their clothing, expressions, actions, background, and composition. Describe the color palette, lighting, and overall style, including any cinematic or artistic qualities like camera angle, depth of field, or motion. Make the description as accurate and faithful to the image as possible. If small details are uncertain or ambiguous, omit them and prioritize capturing the overall scene, mood, and visual impression. The final prompt should be coherent, evocative, written as if by an expert visual artist or filmmaker recreating the exact scene.
caption: A close-up, cinematic shot of a modern office workspace at night, illuminated by the cool, soft glow of dual computer monitors. The main focus is on a pair of hands typing on a keyboard in front of two large screens displaying spreadsheets and bar graphs, suggesting data analysis or office work. The person at the desk wears a plaid shirt and a smartwatch, their posture intent and focused. Another figure, partially visible, reaches into the frame from the right, holding a spray bottle of blue cleaning solution and a yellow microfiber cloth, poised to clean the monitor. The background is dimly lit, with subtle shadows and a hint of clutter—pens, a mug, and office supplies scattered across the desk, adding realism and lived-in detail. The color palette is dominated by cool blues and muted grays, with pops of color from the cleaning solution and desktop items. The lighting is low-key and naturalistic, evoking a late-night, industrious atmosphere. The composition uses a shallow depth of field, keeping the hands, keyboard, and cleaning action in sharp focus while the background recedes softly, creating an intimate, documentary-style feel.
